learned_mechanism: One-shot behavior materially improves progress per NFE and feasibility, but increasing population feedback from roughly every 2000 grazing NFE to every 100 offspring causes frequent full archive nondominated sorting and dominates wall time.
do_not_repeat: Do not treat fewer candidates per behavior as automatically faster when archive maintenance frequency increases.
revisit_condition: Retain one-shot behavior only with buffered or incremental archive maintenance that restores runtime non-inferiority without losing the observed accuracy gain.
next_hypothesis: Batch new nondominated observations in a forage-memory buffer and refresh the social archive every five flock cycles or at a 500-NFE checkpoint.
